title.zh: 卷242 列傳二十九 觉罗果科 敦拜 济席哈 噶达浑 达素
title.en: Volume 242 Biographies 29: Jue Luo Guo Ke, Dun Bai, Ji Xi Ha, Ga Da Hun, Da Su
title.raw: 卷242 列傳二十九 觉罗果科 敦拜 济席哈 噶达浑 达素

sentences.zh: 列傳二十九

translations.literal: Biographies 29
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 29

sentences.zh: 覺羅果科覺羅阿克善敦拜哈寧阿碩詹碩詹孫達色

translations.literal: Aioro Guoke, Aioro Ekeshan, Dunbai, Haning'a, Suozhan, and Dasai, grandson of Suozhan
translations.idiomatic: Aioro Guoke; Aioro Ekeshan; Dunbai; Haning'a; Suozhan; and Dasai, grandson of Suozhan

sentences.zh: 濟席哈弟費雅思哈噶達渾費揚武愛松古興鼐興鼐兄孫哈爾奇

translations.literal: Jixiha, Di Feiyasih'a, Gadahun, Feiyangwu, Aisonggu, Xingnai, and Ha'erqi, grandson of Xingnai's elder brother
translations.idiomatic: Jixiha; Di Feiyasih'a; Gadahun; Feiyangwu; Aisonggu; Xingnai; and Ha'erqi, grandson of Xingnai's elder brother

sentences.zh: 達素喀爾塔喇喀爾塔喇子赫特赫

translations.literal: Dasu, Ka'ertala, and Heteh, son of Ka'ertala
translations.idiomatic: Dasu; Ka'ertala; and Heteh, son of Ka'ertala

sentences.zh: 覺羅果科，滿洲鑲白旗人，未詳其屬籍。

translations.literal: Aioro Guoke was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner; the branch of his lineage is not recorded in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Guoke of the Aioro clan was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner; which branch of the lineage he belonged to is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，授巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He served Emperor Taizong and was appointed a Vanguard company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served Taizong and was appointed a Vanguard company commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年，從伐明，圍錦州，分兵屯杏山河岸。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongde he followed the campaign against the Ming, besieged Jinzhou, and with a detachment encamped on the banks of the Xingshan River.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 6 he took part in the expedition against the Ming. When Jinzhou was besieged, he was sent with a detachment to hold the bank of the Xingshan River.

sentences.zh: 明兵自寧遠至，果科與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦努山擊破之，逐至連山，斬級三十，得馬三十二。

translations.literal: Ming troops came from Ningyuan; Guoke, together with Gabushixian gushan i janggin Nushan, defeated them, pursued them to Lianshan, beheaded thirty men, and captured thirty-two horses.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces advanced from Ningyuan, Guoke and the Gabushixian corps commander Nushan routed them, pursued them as far as Lianshan, took thirty heads, and seized thirty-two horses.

sentences.zh: 七年，與努山略寧遠，明兵自中後所犯我牧地，擊之潰遁。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with Nushan he raided toward Ningyuan; Ming troops from Zhonghousuo invaded our pasturelands, and he attacked them until they broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Nushan conducted a raid toward Ningyuan. When Ming troops from Zhonghousuo struck our pasturelands, he attacked them and drove them off in rout.

sentences.zh: 八年，復與努山至界嶺口诇明兵，與戰，斬裨將一、步騎三百餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again went with Nushan to Jieling Pass to reconnoiter Ming forces, fought them, and beheaded one assistant commander and more than three hundred infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he again joined Nushan at Jieling Pass to scout Ming movements, gave battle, and killed one deputy commander along with more than three hundred foot and horse.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，追至慶都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass with the main armies, struck Li Zicheng, and pursued him as far as Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格下陝西，克綏德。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige into Shaanxi and captured Suide.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige into Shaanxi and took Suide.

sentences.zh: 自成兄子錦據延安，果科與巴牙喇纛章京希爾根三戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Zicheng's nephew Jin held Yan'an; Guoke and the Vanguard banner commander Xiergen fought three engagements and won them all.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng's nephew Jin was holding Yan'an; Guoke and the Vanguard banner commander Xiergen fought three battles and won each one.

sentences.zh: 自成奔湖廣，師從之，次安陸，迭擊敗之，得舟八十。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled to Huguang; the army followed, halted at Anlu, repeatedly defeated him, and captured eighty boats.
translations.idiomatic: When Zicheng fled into Huguang, the army followed. At Anlu they defeated him again and again and seized eighty boats.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，經漢中，擊叛將賀珍，進次西充，破獻忠，復與希爾根搜剿餘寇。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge against Zhang Xianzhong, passed through Hanzhong, attacked the rebel general He Zhen, advanced to Xichong, defeated Xianzhong, and again with Xiergen searched out and suppressed remnant bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge in the campaign against Zhang Xianzhong. The route went through Hanzhong; they struck the rebel He Zhen, pushed on to Xichong, broke Xianzhong, and then Guoke and Xiergen swept up the remaining rebels.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗下湖南，授巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala into Hunan and was appointed a Vanguard company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala into Hunan and again received appointment as a Vanguard company commander.

sentences.zh: 攻湘潭，明總督何騰蛟城守，果科與噶布什賢章京瑚沙破西門入。

translations.literal: They attacked Xiangtan; Ming governor He Tengjiao defended the city; Guoke and the Gabushixian janggin Husha broke in through the west gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the assault on Xiangtan, where Ming governor He Tengjiao held the walls, Guoke and the Gabushixian commander Husha forced the west gate and entered the city.

sentences.zh: 尋與固山額真佟圖賴率兵趨衡州，擊破明兵，攻拔石橋寨。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, with gushan ejen Toto, he led troops toward Hengzhou, defeated Ming forces, and stormed Shiqiao stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined gushan ejen Toto in a march on Hengzhou, routed the Ming army, and took Shiqiao stockade.

sentences.zh: 又擊破明將周進唐、胡一清等，逐一清至全州。

translations.literal: He again defeated the Ming generals Zhou Jintang, Hu Yiqing, and others, pursued Yiqing to Quanzhou, and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: He next defeated the Ming commanders Zhou Jintang and Hu Yiqing, among others, and chased Yiqing all the way to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was appointed an acting official of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he was appointed an acting official in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，並以監修壇廟，世職累進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls; he benefited from an amnesty edict and from supervising repairs to altars and temples, and his hereditary rank was advanced in stages to second-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, an amnesty edict and his oversight of altar and temple repairs together raised his hereditary rank step by step to second-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighteenth year.

sentences.zh: 追坐修倉糜費，罰鍰，降世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was held accountable for waste in granary repairs, fined, and his hereditary rank was reduced to tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: After his death he was posthumously charged with waste in granary repairs, fined, and his hereditary rank was cut to tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 聖祖親政，其子薩爾布訴枉，復拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor took personal rule, his son Sa'erbu pleaded that the penalty was unjust, and the rank of tabuleha fan was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After the Kangxi Emperor assumed personal rule, his son Sa'erbu appealed that the punishment had been wrongful, and the tabuleha fan rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 覺羅阿克善，滿洲正黃旗人，景祖兄索長阿三世孫。

translations.literal: Aioro Ekeshan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, a third-generation descendant of Jingzu's elder brother Socanga.
translations.idiomatic: Ekeshan of the Aioro clan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a great-great-grandson of Jingzu's elder brother Socanga.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: He served Emperor Taizong and was appointed a jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He served Taizong and was appointed a jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年，圍錦州，與果科同在行，擊敗明總兵吳三桂及松山、杏山援軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongde, during the siege of Jinzhou, he was on campaign with Guoke and defeated Ming regional commander Wu Sangui and the relief forces from Songshan and Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 6, when Jinzhou was besieged, he campaigned alongside Guoke and routed Ming regional commander Wu Sangui and the Songshan and Xingshan relief columns.

sentences.zh: 師還，明兵襲梅勒額真索海軍，阿克善與巴牙喇纛章京伊爾德赴援，擊卻之，又屢擊敗總督洪承疇軍，授半個前程。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Ming troops attacked meile ejen Suohai's force; Ekeshan and the Vanguard banner commander Irde went to the rescue and drove them back, and he repeatedly defeated the army of Governor Hong Chengchou and was granted half a qianjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home, Ming forces struck meile ejen Suohai's detachment; Ekeshan and the Vanguard banner commander Irde hurried to relieve them and beat the enemy back. He also defeated Governor Hong Chengchou's army several times and received half a qianjing.

sentences.zh: 八年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗伐明，攻寧遠，分兵攻前屯衛，先登，克其城。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in a campaign against the Ming, attacked Ningyuan, detached troops to assault Qiantunwei, was first over the wall, and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala against the Ming. At Ningyuan he sent a detachment against Qiantunwei, was the first man up the wall, and took the town.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass with the main armies.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢正黃旗滿洲梅勒額真，兼工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to meile ejen of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and concurrently served as vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became meile ejen of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner while also serving as vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 八年，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was moved to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 敘功，並遇恩詔，進世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls; he also benefited from an amnesty edict, and his hereditary rank was advanced to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, together with an amnesty edict his hereditary rank rose to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 九年，與固山額真噶達渾徵蒙古鄂爾多斯部，殲其眾於賀蘭山。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with gushan ejen Gadahun, he campaigned against the Mongol Ordos tribes and annihilated their force at Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined gushan ejen Gadahun in a campaign against the Ordos Mongols and destroyed their force at Helan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 總兵任珍殺其孥，賄兵部寢勿治，事發，阿克善罷侍郎，降世職拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Regional commander Ren Zhen killed his wife and children; he bribed the Ministry of War to let the case lie, but when the matter came out Ekeshan was removed as vice minister and his hereditary rank was reduced to tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Ren Zhen murdered his family, then bribed the Ministry of War to bury the case. When the scandal broke, Ekeshan was stripped of his vice ministership and his hereditary rank was cut to tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，暫署都察院左都御史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he temporarily acted as left censor-in-chief of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served temporarily as left censor-in-chief of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 從征湖廣，戰湘潭、常德、龍陽，屢捷。

translations.literal: He followed the Huguang campaign, fought at Xiangtan, Changde, and Longyang, and won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: On the Huguang campaign he fought at Xiangtan, Changde, and Longyang and won victory after victory.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從鄭親王世子濟度討鄭成功，師次烏龍江，水險不可渡，又間道趨福州，分兵令牛錄額真褚庫先驅擊成功，署巴牙喇纛章京伊色克圖擊成功舟師，遂至福州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he followed Prince Zheng's heir Jidu against Zheng Chenggong; the army halted at the Wulong River, where the waters were too dangerous to cross, then took a side route toward Fuzhou, detached troops with niru ejen Chuku to strike Chenggong in advance, and had acting Vanguard banner commander Isektu attack Chenggong's fleet, and thus reached Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he followed Prince Zheng's heir Jidu against Zheng Chenggong. The army stopped at the Wulong River, where the current was too treacherous to ford, then swung by a side road toward Fuzhou. Chuku, a niru ejen, was sent ahead with a detachment against Chenggong, while acting Vanguard banner commander Isektu engaged Chenggong's fleet, and the column reached Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 諜言成功舟三百泊烏龍江，阿克善等水陸合擊，逐敵至三江口，斬其將林祖蘭等，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Intelligence reported that three hundred of Chenggong's boats were moored on the Wulong River; Ekeshan and others attacked by land and water together, pursued the enemy to Sanjiangkou, beheaded their general Lin Zulan and others, and took a great number captive.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported three hundred of Chenggong's vessels at anchor on the Wulong River. Ekeshan and his colleagues struck by land and sea, chased the enemy to Sanjiangkou, killed their commander Lin Zulan and others, and took a large number of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 十四年，成功兵侵羅源，阿克善督兵赴援，力戰死之，進世職三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Chenggong's troops invaded Luoyuan; Ekeshan led troops to the relief, fought fiercely, and died in battle; his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, when Chenggong's forces invaded Luoyuan, Ekeshan hurried troops to the rescue, fought to the death, and was posthumously raised to third-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 敦拜，富察氏，滿洲正黃旗人，先世居沙濟。

translations.literal: Dunbai, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner; his forebears had long dwelt at Shaji.
translations.idiomatic: Dunbai of the Fuca clan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner whose family had long lived at Shaji.

sentences.zh: 父本科理，歸太祖。

translations.literal: His father Benkeli submitted to Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Benkeli had submitted to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 嘗從鄂佛洛總管達賴討硃舍理部長尤額楞，有功，賜號蘇赫巴圖魯，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: He once followed Supervisor Efolo Dalai in attacking Zhusheli chieftain You'eling, performed meritorious service, was granted the title Suhebatulu, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He had once followed Supervisor Efolo Dalai against Zhusheli chieftain You'eling, distinguished himself, received the honorific Suhebatulu, and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 卒，敦拜嗣。

translations.literal: When he died, Dunbai succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: On his death Dunbai inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 天命十一年，從太祖攻寧遠，先驅，敗城兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianming he followed Taizu in the attack on Ningyuan as vanguard and defeated the city troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 11 he followed Taizu against Ningyuan in the van and routed the garrison.

sentences.zh: 師還，敵騎追射，敦拜還擊卻敵，殿而歸。

translations.literal: When the army returned, enemy horsemen pursued and shot at them; Dunbai turned back, struck, and drove the enemy off, covering the rear on the march home.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home enemy cavalry pursued and harried the column; Dunbai wheeled about, beat them back, and brought up the rear.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5 he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍錦州，城兵出誘戰，敦拜突入敵隊中，斬三人，眾悉遁。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in besieging Jinzhou; the garrison came out to offer battle as a lure; Dunbai charged into the enemy ranks, beheaded three men, and the whole force fled.
translations.idiomatic: During Prince Zheng Jirhala's siege of Jinzhou, the garrison sallied to bait a fight; Dunbai plunged into the enemy line, killed three men, and the whole body broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 明兵自杏山再來犯，皆戰卻之。

translations.literal: Ming troops came again from Xingshan to attack, and in each encounter he fought them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces again advanced from Xingshan, he repulsed them in every clash.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，明兵自松山攻兩紅旗及蒙古軍，敦拜禦敵力戰，斬二百餘級，得云梯十四。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Jinzhou was besieged again; Ming troops from Songshan attacked the Two Red Banners and the Mongol forces; Dunbai met the enemy and fought fiercely, beheading more than two hundred men and capturing fourteen scaling ladders.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Jinzhou was besieged again, Ming columns from Songshan struck the Two Red Banners and the Mongol troops. Dunbai met them head-on, took more than two hundred heads, and seized fourteen scaling ladders.

sentences.zh: 七年，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was granted half a qianjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he received half a qianjing.

sentences.zh: 八年，與巴牙喇纛章京阿濟格尼堪率師駐錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, together with Vanguard banner commander Ajigenikan, he led troops stationed at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and Vanguard banner commander Ajigenikan commanded the garrison at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，逐之至慶都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass, struck Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 二年，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the second year his hereditary rank was advanced to second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year his hereditary rank rose to second-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 大將軍豫親王多鐸南征，敦拜將巴牙喇兵從。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince Yu Dodo marched south; Dunbai led Vanguard troops in his train.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Marshal Prince Yu Dodo marched south, Dunbai commanded the Vanguard contingent that followed him.

sentences.zh: 次陝州，破自成將劉方亮，方亮兵夜襲營，复擊敗之。

translations.literal: The army halted at Shaanzhou and defeated Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang; Fangliang's troops raided the camp by night, and he again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At Shaanzhou they routed Li Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang. When Fangliang's men raided the camp by night, Dunbai beat them back again.

sentences.zh: 克潼關，定西安。

translations.literal: They captured Tong Pass and secured Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: They took Tong Pass and secured Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 自成走商州，入湖廣，敦拜與巴牙喇纛章京阿爾津等追斬三百餘級。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled toward Shangzhou and entered Huguang; Dunbai, together with Vanguard banner commander A'erjin and others, pursued and beheaded more than three hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng fled toward Shangzhou and into Huguang; Dunbai, the Vanguard banner commander A'erjin, and others pursued and cut down more than three hundred of his men.

sentences.zh: 從豫親王下江南，克揚州，薄明南都。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Yu into the lower Yangzi region, captured Yangzhou, and pressed close to the Southern Ming capital.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Yu into the lower Yangzi, took Yangzhou, and closed on the Southern Ming capital.

sentences.zh: 追明福王至蕪湖，與阿爾津、圖賴等截江口，擊破明將黃得功，得明福王以歸。

translations.literal: They pursued the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu; with A'erjin, Toto, and others he blocked the river mouth, defeated the Ming general Huang Degong, and brought the Ming Prince of Fu back captive.
translations.idiomatic: They chased the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu. With A'erjin, Toto, and others Dunbai sealed the river mouth, routed Huang Degong, and brought the Prince of Fu back as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 三年，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the third year his hereditary rank was advanced to the first grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year his hereditary rank rose to the first grade.

sentences.zh: 從端重親王博洛自浙江徇福建，與梅勒額真珠瑪喇合軍破敵。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo from Zhejiang into Fujian and, joining forces with meile ejen Jumara, defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo from Zhejiang into Fujian and, together with meile ejen Jumara, broke the enemy.

sentences.zh: 五年，從大將軍譚泰討金聲桓，攻九江，破王得仁軍，克之，撫臨江郡縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Grand Marshal Tan Tai against Jin Shenghuan, attacked Jiujiang, defeated Wang Deren's army, captured the city, and pacified the prefectures and counties of Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Grand Marshal Tan Tai against Jin Shenghuan, stormed Jiujiang, routed Wang Deren, took the city, and pacified the Linjiang prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 六年，剿畿南土寇，斬其渠，獻、雄、任丘、寶坻諸縣悉定。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he suppressed bandits south of the capital region, beheaded their leader, and the counties of Xian, Xiong, Renqiu, Baodi, and others were all secured.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he suppressed bandits south of the capital, killed their chieftain, and brought Xian, Xiong, Renqiu, Baodi, and the surrounding counties under control.

sentences.zh: 七年，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year his hereditary rank rose to third-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 尋從睿親王畋於中後所，坐私出獵，降世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, while hunting with Prince Rui at Zhonghousuo, he was punished for going out to hunt on his own authority, and his hereditary rank was reduced to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, on a hunt with Prince Rui at Zhonghousuo, he was punished for hunting on his own initiative and his hereditary rank was cut to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 八年，上親政，复世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the emperor took personal rule, his hereditary rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when the emperor assumed personal rule, his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 九年，進二等。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was advanced to the second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was raised to the second grade.

sentences.zh: 十一年，明將李定國犯廣東，命佐將軍珠瑪喇討之，克新會，逐之至橫州江岸，定國引去。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Ming general Li Dingguo invaded Guangdong; he was ordered to assist General Jumara in suppressing him, captured Xinhui, pursued him to the bank of the Hengzhou River, and Dingguo withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when the Ming general Li Dingguo invaded Guangdong, Dunbai was ordered to assist General Jumara. They took Xinhui, chased Dingguo to the Hengzhou River, and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 師還，晉世職一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his hereditary rank was advanced to first-class jingqinihafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return his hereditary rank was raised to first-class jingqinihafan.

sentences.zh: 以病乞休，加太子太保。

translations.literal: He requested retirement on grounds of illness and was given the additional title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Citing illness, he asked to retire and was granted the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十四年，起為盛京總管。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled to serve as superintendent of Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was recalled to serve as superintendent of Mukden.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died and was given the posthumous title Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year and was posthumously titled Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign his enfeoffment was fixed as first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the family enfeoffment was fixed at first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 富察之族，有哈寧阿、碩詹、濟席哈、費雅斯哈，皆以武功顯。

translations.literal: Among the Fuca clan were Haning'a, Suozhan, Jixiha, and Feiyasih'a, all of whom won distinction through military achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuca clan also produced Haning'a, Suozhan, Jixiha, and Feiyasih'a, each of whom rose to prominence on the battlefield.

sentences.zh: 哈寧阿，滿洲鑲白旗人，世居額宜湖。

translations.literal: Haning'a was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner whose family had long dwelt at Eyihu.
translations.idiomatic: Haning'a was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner from a family that had long lived at Eyihu.

sentences.zh: 父阿爾圖山，率其族攻薩齊庫城，殺其部長喀穆蘇尼堪，撫降三百餘人，以歸太祖，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Altushan led his clan to attack Saqiku city, killed its chieftain Kamusunikan, accepted the surrender of more than three hundred people, submitted to Taizu, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Altushan led the clan against Saqiku, killed chieftain Kamusunikan, brought more than three hundred people over by persuasion, submitted to Taizu, and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 既，復分其眾別編一牛錄，以命​​哈寧阿。

translations.literal: Thereafter part of the people was again separated and organized as a separate niru, which was placed under Haning'a's command.
translations.idiomatic: Later part of the followers was split off into a separate niru and assigned to Haning'a.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，從貝勒岳託等伐明，略錦州，攻松山、杏山、高橋諸台堡，戰甚力，授巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong he followed Beile Yoto and others in a campaign against the Ming, raided toward Jinzhou, attacked the stockades at Songshan, Xingshan, Gaoqiao, and elsewhere, fought with great exertion, and was appointed Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 he followed Beile Yoto against the Ming, raided toward Jinzhou, and stormed the stockades at Songshan, Xingshan, Gaoqiao, and elsewhere. For his fierce fighting he was made Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，從伐明，薄明都，與袁崇煥戰廣渠門外，以功授世職備禦。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against the Ming, pressed close to the Ming capital, fought Yuan Chonghuan outside Guangqumen, and for his merit was granted the hereditary rank of beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the Ming campaign, closed on the capital, fought Yuan Chonghuan outside Guangqumen, and received the hereditary rank of beiyu for his service.

sentences.zh: 五年，從攻大凌河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the attack on Dalinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he took part in the assault on Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 八年，從攻大同，哈寧阿先驅，至小西城，樹雲梯以攻，克之，復將二十人出戰，敗敵兵三百。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed the attack on Datong; Haning'a served as vanguard, reached Xiaoxicheng, set up scaling ladders to assault it, and captured it; he then led twenty men out to fight and defeated three hundred enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the Datong campaign, Haning'a led the van to Xiaoxicheng, took the place with scaling ladders, then sallied with twenty men and routed three hundred enemy soldiers.

sentences.zh: 九年，與承政圖爾格入明邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with cheng zheng Turgut, he entered the Ming frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he crossed into Ming territory with cheng zheng Turgut.

sentences.zh: 師還，道平魯衛，明兵躡師後，還擊敗之，逐薄壕，多所斬馘，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: On the return march, passing Pingluwei, Ming troops followed close behind the army; he turned back, defeated them, pursued them to press against the moat, beheaded and killed many, and was advanced to second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home, near Pingluwei, Ming forces dogged the rear; he wheeled about, routed them, pressed them to the moat, and killed a great number. His rank rose to second-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從攻皮島。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the attack on Pidao.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the assault on Pidao.

sentences.zh: 二年，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed a deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 三年，從豫親王多鐸如錦州會師，道中後所，祖大壽以輕騎掩我師，甲喇額真翁克及土默特兵先奔，哈寧阿且戰且退，士卒有死者，論罪當死，上貸之，命奪世職，籍家產之半。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo to join forces at Jinzhou; on the route past Zhonghousuo, Zu Dashou with light cavalry surprised our army; jalan ejen Wengke and the Tumed troops fled first; Haning'a fought while retreating and some soldiers died; by law the offense merited death, but the emperor pardoned him, ordered his hereditary rank seized, and registered half his household property.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo to the rendezvous at Jinzhou. Near Zhonghousuo, Zu Dashou surprised the column with light cavalry. Jalan ejen Wengke and the Tumed troops broke first; Haning'a fought a fighting retreat and lost men. The statute called for death, but the emperor spared him, stripped his hereditary rank, and confiscated half his estate.

sentences.zh: 四年，復以庇牛錄額真阿蘭太失律，論罪當死，上复貸之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he again shielded niru ejen Alantai when the latter violated discipline; by law the offense merited death, and the emperor again pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he again covered for niru ejen Alantai after a disciplinary breach. Once more the statute called for death, and once more the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，屢敗敵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the siege of Jinzhou and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, during the siege of Jinzhou, he routed the enemy again and again.

sentences.zh: 明總督洪承疇赴援，上督諸軍環松山而營，度明師且遁，遣諸將分地為伏以待。

translations.literal: Ming Governor Hong Chengchou came to the relief; the emperor personally supervised the armies encamped around Songshan, judged that the Ming force would soon flee, and dispatched the generals to take up ambush positions in divided sectors to await them.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming governor Hong Chengchou marched to relieve the siege, the emperor oversaw the armies ringing Songshan, judged that the Ming column would break and run, and sent his generals to lay ambushes sector by sector.

sentences.zh: 哈寧阿與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜陣於海濱，夜初更，明師循海走，哈寧阿等起掩擊，明師蹂藉，死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Haning'a and Vanguard banner commander Oboi were stationed on the seashore; at the first watch of the night the Ming army fled along the coast; Haning'a and the others rose and struck from concealment; the Ming troops were trampled down and the dead were very many.
translations.idiomatic: Haning'a and Vanguard banner commander Oboi held the coast. At the first watch the Ming army fled along the shore; they sprang the ambush, and the fleeing column was crushed underfoot with enormous slaughter.

sentences.zh: 尋進攻松山，屢敗敵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they advanced to attack Songshan and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: They then pressed the attack on Songshan and defeated the enemy repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，與巴牙喇纛章京阿爾津伐虎爾哈部，俘男婦二千五百有奇，獲牲畜、貂皮無算。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year, together with Vanguard banner commander A'erjin, he campaigned against the Hurha tribes, captured more than twenty-five hundred men and women, and took livestock and sable pelts beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year he and Vanguard banner commander A'erjin campaigned against the Hurha tribes, taking more than twenty-five hundred captives and countless livestock and sable pelts.

sentences.zh: 師還，上厚賚之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the emperor richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return the emperor rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，戰慶都，再戰真定，自成焚輜重走。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, fought at Qingdu, fought again at Zhending, and Zicheng burned his baggage train and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass against Li Zicheng, fought at Qingdu and again at Zhending, until Zicheng burned his baggage and fled.

sentences.zh: 二年，复授世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the second year his hereditary rank of third-class jalan janggin was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year his third-class jalan janggin rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 逐賊綏德，徇延安，戰破城兵。

translations.literal: He pursued the bandits to Suide, marched through Yan'an, fought, and defeated the city troops.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the rebels to Suide, swept through Yan'an, and broke the garrison in battle.

sentences.zh: 南逐自成，戰安陸，得舟八十。

translations.literal: He pursued Zicheng south, fought at Anlu, and captured eighty boats.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing Zicheng south, he fought at Anlu and seized eighty boats.

sentences.zh: 復與譚泰合兵下江南，戰江上，奪敵舟。

translations.literal: He again joined Tan Tai's united force into the lower Yangzi region, fought on the river, and seized enemy boats.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Tan Tai's combined force in the lower Yangzi, fought on the river, and took enemy vessels.

sentences.zh: 逐敵至富池口，敵據江岸為陣，复擊之敗。

translations.literal: They pursued the enemy to Fuchikou; the enemy held the riverbank in battle formation, and he again attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: They chased the enemy to Fuchikou, where the foe drew up along the bank; he attacked again and routed them.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，從順承郡王勒克德渾略湖廣，破明將吳汝義，降甚★。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he followed Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun in a raid through Huguang, defeated the Ming general Wu Ruyi, and very many surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he followed Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun on a sweep through Huguang, defeated the Ming commander Wu Ruyi, and accepted mass surrenders.

sentences.zh: 四月，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month his rank was advanced to second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month his rank rose to second-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 五月，從肅親王豪格討叛將賀珍，取漢中，逐賊至秦州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he followed Prince Su Haoge against the rebel general He Zhen, took Hanzhong, and pursued the bandits to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he followed Prince Su Haoge against the rebel He Zhen, took Hanzhong, and drove the rebels to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 珍黨武大定據三寨山，山勢峻不可攻，師圍之。

translations.literal: Zhen's partisan Wu Dading held Sanzhai Mountain; the terrain was steep and could not be assaulted, so the army besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: He's follower Wu Dading held Sanzhai Mountain, whose steep slopes defied direct assault, so the army laid siege.

sentences.zh: 會其將周克德、石國璽皆乞​​降，克德遣其子導師自僻徑登，國璽為內應，哈寧阿與梅勒額真阿拉善、署巴牙喇纛章京噶達渾將六百人破壘入，賊皆自投崖下，斬殺略盡。

translations.literal: It happened that his generals Zhou Kede and Shi Guoxi both begged to surrender; Kede sent his son to guide the army up by a secluded path, Guoxi acted as an inside collaborator, and Haning'a, together with meile ejen Alashan and acting Vanguard banner commander Gadahun, led six hundred men to break into the stockade; the bandits all threw themselves from the cliffs, and nearly all were beheaded or killed.
translations.idiomatic: His officers Zhou Kede and Shi Guoxi both offered to surrender. Kede's son guided the troops up a hidden path while Guoxi worked from within. Haning'a, meile ejen Alashan, and acting Vanguard commander Gadahun led six hundred men through the fortifications; the rebels leaped from the cliffs, and nearly all were cut down.

sentences.zh: 進討張獻忠，徇夔州、茂州、資州、遵義，皆下。

translations.literal: They advanced against Zhang Xianzhong and marched through Kuizhou, Maozhou, Zizhou, and Zunyi; all were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the campaign against Zhang Xianzhong, they swept through Kuizhou, Maozhou, Zizhou, and Zunyi, taking each in turn.

sentences.zh: 五年，師還，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the army returned, his rank was advanced to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the army's return, his hereditary rank rose to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died not long after.

sentences.zh: 碩詹，滿洲正紅旗人，世居訥殷。

translations.literal: Suozhan was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner whose family had long dwelt at Neyin.
translations.idiomatic: Suozhan was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner from a family that had long lived at Neyin.

sentences.zh: 父舒穆祿，歸太祖，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Shumulu submitted to Taizu and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shumulu had submitted to Taizu and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 卒，碩詹嗣，尋兼甲喇額真。

translations.literal: When he died, Suozhan succeeded him and soon also held the post of jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: On his death Suozhan inherited the post and soon also served as jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，與甲喇額真杭什木、沙爾虎達等略明邊，遇邏卒，斬其三，俘其五及邏卒長。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong, together with jalan ejen Hangshimu, Sharhuda, and others, he raided the Ming frontier, encountered border scouts, beheaded three of them, and captured five men together with the scout leader.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he joined jalan ejen Hangshimu, Sharhuda, and others on a raid along the Ming frontier, killed three border scouts, and took five prisoners along with their leader.

sentences.zh: 八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，攻江華島，碩詹舟越朝鮮戰艦，繼牛錄額真阿哈尼堪以登，率眾合圍，降其城，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Korea and attacked Ganghwa Island; Suozhan's boat crossed over Korean warships, followed niru ejen Ahanikan in boarding, led the troops in closing the encirclement, and reduced the city; he was granted half a qianjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1, on the Korean campaign, he attacked Ganghwa Island. Suozhan's boat crossed above the Korean warships; following niru ejen Ahanikan he boarded, closed the encirclement, and took the town, earning half a qianjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，兼刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he concurrently served as an acting official of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he also served as an acting official in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，深入山東，克禹城、平陰。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against the Ming, penetrated deep into Shandong, and captured Yucheng and Pingyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he pushed deep into Shandong and took Yucheng and Pingyin.

sentences.zh: 四年，師還，明兵襲我後軍，與巴圖魯尼哈里等擊卻之，進世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the return march, Ming troops attacked our rear guard; together with the baturu Ni'eri and others he fought them off, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, as the army marched home, Ming forces struck the rear. With the baturu Ni'eri and others he drove them back, and his hereditary rank rose to third-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 擢戶部參政。

translations.literal: He was promoted to a participating secretary of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to participating secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五年，師伐明，命碩詹如朝鮮徵糧及水師助戰。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the army campaigned against the Ming, Suozhan was ordered to go to Korea to levy grain and bring the fleet to assist in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, during the Ming campaign, he was sent to Korea to levy grain and bring the fleet into action.

sentences.zh: 從圍錦州，甲喇額真禧福率甲士二十四駐守駱駝山，明兵四百夜劫營，碩詹赴援，斬二百餘級，得馬十六。

translations.literal: He followed the siege of Jinzhou; jalan ejen Xifu led twenty-four armored soldiers to garrison Luotuo Mountain; four hundred Ming troops raided the camp by night; Suozhan went to the relief, beheaded more than two hundred men, and captured sixteen horses.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jinzhou siege, jalan ejen Xifu held Luotuo Mountain with twenty-four armored men. When four hundred Ming troops raided the camp at night, Suozhan rushed to the rescue, took more than two hundred heads, and seized sixteen horses.

sentences.zh: 七年，領本旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he headed the meile ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became meile ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，改侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass and was made a vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass and was appointed a vice minister.

sentences.zh: 上將遷都燕京，命碩詹統右翼兵留守盛京。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to move the capital to Yanjing, Suozhan was ordered to command the Right Wing troops left to guard Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: As the court prepared to move the capital to Yanjing, Suozhan was ordered to command the Right Wing troops left behind at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 尋復命從豫親王多鐸南征，自河南徇陝西，遂移師定江南。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered to follow Prince Yu Dodo on the southern expedition, marched from Henan into Shaanxi, and then shifted the army to secure the lower Yangzi region.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to follow Prince Yu Dodo south, swept from Henan into Shaanxi, and then turned the army to pacify the lower Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 敘功，世職累進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls, and his hereditary rank was advanced in stages to first-class adahahan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, his hereditary rank rose step by step to first-class adahahan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗徵湖南，偕都統佟圖賴等師出湘潭，明兵阻橋立寨，與固山額真伊拜、巴牙喇甲喇章京覺羅果科共擊下之，斬其將陶養用，衡州平。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in the Hunan campaign; together with dutong Toto and others the army marched out from Xiangtan; Ming troops blocked the bridge and set up a stockade; together with gushan ejen Ibai and Vanguard company commander Aioro Guoke he stormed it down, beheaded their general Tao Yangyong, and Hengzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala into Hunan. With dutong Toto and others the column moved out from Xiangtan, where Ming forces had barricaded the bridge with a stockade. Suozhan, gushan ejen Ibai, and Vanguard commander Aioro Guoke stormed the position, killed Tao Yangyong, and pacified Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，賚白金三百，進世職一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was bestowed three hundred taels of white silver and his hereditary rank was advanced to first-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received three hundred taels of silver and was raised to first-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 八年，坐戶部給餉不均，降世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was punished for unequal distribution of rations by the Ministry of Revenue, and his hereditary rank was reduced to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was punished for uneven rationing in the Ministry of Revenue and his hereditary rank was cut to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 九年，以老病罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was dismissed on grounds of age and illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he retired on grounds of age and illness.

sentences.zh: 十年，命复世職。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was ordered to have his hereditary rank restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，卒，諡明敏。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi he died and was given the posthumous title Mingmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 2 and was posthumously titled Mingmin.

sentences.zh: 以其孫達色、法色分襲世職，並授二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His grandsons Dasai and Fase divided the inherited rank between them, and each was granted second-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: His grandsons Dasai and Fase split the hereditary rank between them, each receiving second-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 達色以參領從征福建，戰屢捷。

translations.literal: Dasai followed the Fujian campaign as a company leader and won repeated victories in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Dasai served as a company leader on the Fujian campaign and won battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 鄭錦將劉國軒眾萬餘犯海澄，達色赴援，冒槍砲力戰，聞城陷，自經死，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Zheng Jing's general Liu Guoxuan led more than ten thousand men in an attack on Haicheng; Dasai went to the relief, braved musket and cannon fire and fought fiercely; when he heard the city had fallen he hanged himself; he was posthumously granted tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Jing's general Liu Guoxuan invaded Haicheng with more than ten thousand men, Dasai hurried to the rescue and fought through musket and cannon fire. Learning the city had fallen, he hanged himself and was posthumously granted tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 法色兼襲，復合為一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Fase held both inheritances jointly, and the ranks were again combined as first-class ashanihafan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Fase held both lines of inheritance, and the combined rank became first-class ashanihafan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 子明寶，雍正間從征西藏，有功，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: His son Mingbao, during the Yongzheng reign, followed the Tibet campaign, performed meritorious service, and was advanced to third-class jingqinihafan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingbao served on the Tibet campaign in the Yongzheng era, distinguished himself, and was raised to third-class jingqinihafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，改三等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign the enfeoffment was changed to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the title was fixed as third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 子德成，降襲三等男。

translations.literal: His son Decheng inherited at a reduced grade as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: His son Decheng inherited at the reduced rank of third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 濟席哈，亦富察氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Jixiha, also of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jixiha, likewise of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父本科里，官牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Benkeli held the post of niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Benkeli had served as niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 濟席哈初亦授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Jixiha at first was also appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Jixiha too was first appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德四年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongde he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 4 he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，從伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the campaign against the Ming and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the Ming campaign and helped besiege Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 明兵自松山至，邀戰，與甲喇額真布丹、希爾根等擊卻之。

translations.literal: Ming troops came from Songshan and offered battle; together with jalan ejen Budan, Xiergen, and others he fought them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces advanced from Songshan and offered battle, he and jalan ejen Budan, Xiergen, and others drove them back.

sentences.zh: 尋駐義州護屯田，上誡諸將固守營壘，勿與明兵戰。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was stationed at Yizhou to guard the military colonies; the emperor admonished the generals to hold fast to their camps and not engage Ming troops in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He was then posted at Yizhou to guard the military colonies. The emperor warned the generals to hold their camps and avoid fighting Ming troops.

sentences.zh: 明兵犯鑲藍旗營，濟席哈越鑲紅旗營助戰，以擅離汛地，奪官，籍其家三之一。

translations.literal: Ming troops attacked the Bordered Blue Banner camp; Jixiha crossed through the Bordered Red Banner camp to assist in battle; for leaving his post without authorization he was stripped of office and one-third of his household property was registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces struck the Bordered Blue Banner camp, Jixiha crossed through the Bordered Red Banner lines to help. For leaving his post without orders he was dismissed and one-third of his estate was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 旋與梅勒額真席特庫伐索倫部，得其部長博穆博果爾以歸。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, together with meile ejen Xituku, he campaigned against the Solon tribes and brought back their chieftain Bomboguo'er.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined meile ejen Xituku against the Solon tribes and brought back their chieftain Bomboguo'er.

sentences.zh: 六年，師還，與宴勞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the army returned, he was given a feast in reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the army's return, he was feasted in reward.

sentences.zh: 七年，授正紅旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed meile ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became meile ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，兼戶部參政。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he concurrently served as a participating secretary of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he also served as participating secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，追之至慶都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass, struck Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls and he was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, he received the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.

sentences.zh: 二年，從端重親王博洛下浙江，既克杭州，以梅勒額真駐守。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo into Zhejiang; after Hangzhou was taken he was stationed there as meile ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo into Zhejiang and, once Hangzhou fell, remained there as meile ejen.

sentences.zh: 明大學士馬士英、總兵方國安據嚴州，屢來犯，濟席哈督兵御之，五戰皆捷。

translations.literal: The Ming grand secretary Ma Shiying and regional commander Fang Guo'an held Yanzhou and repeatedly came to attack; Jixiha directed troops to resist them and won all five engagements.
translations.idiomatic: Ming grand secretary Ma Shiying and regional commander Fang Guo'an held Yanzhou and attacked repeatedly; Jixiha commanded the defense and won all five battles.

sentences.zh: 還京，授工部侍郎，加世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: On his return to the capital he was appointed vice minister of Works and given the additional hereditary rank of tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital he was made vice minister of Works and granted the additional hereditary rank of tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 五年，命率兵駐東昌。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to lead troops stationed at Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was ordered to garrison Dongchang with his troops.

sentences.zh: 尋以鄭彩寇福建，命從將軍陳泰南征，克長樂、連江、同安、平和諸縣，進世職二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because Zheng Cai raided Fujian, he was ordered to follow General Chen Tai on the southern expedition, captured Changle, Lianjiang, Tong'an, Pinghe, and other counties, and his hereditary rank was advanced to second-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Cai raided Fujian he was sent to follow General Chen Tai south, took Changle, Lianjiang, Tong'an, Pinghe, and other counties, and was raised to second-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 七年，調刑部，擢尚書，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, promoted to minister, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he moved to the Ministry of Punishments, became minister, and was raised to third-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 九年，授正紅旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 十年，解尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was relieved of the ministership.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he left the ministership.

sentences.zh: 膠州總兵海時行叛，命與梅勒額真瑚沙討之，未至，時行走宿州降。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou regional commander Hai Shixing rebelled; he was ordered to join meile ejen Husha in suppressing him, but before they arrived Shixing fled to Suzhou and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiaozhou commander Hai Shixing rebelled, he was ordered to join meile ejen Husha to suppress him, but Shixing fled to Suzhou and surrendered before they arrived.

sentences.zh: 詔移兵鎮湖南。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his troops transferred to garrison Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to move his troops to garrison Hunan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，召還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命率梅勒額真四、巴牙喇甲喇章京八，從大將軍貝子羅託徵雲南。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to lead four meile ejen and eight Vanguard company commanders to follow Grand Marshal Prince Luotuo in the Yunnan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to lead four meile ejen and eight Vanguard company commanders under Grand Marshal Prince Luotuo against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，命佐將軍卓布泰，師進次都勻，擊敗明將李定國。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was ordered to assist General Zhuobutai; the army advanced and halted at Duyun and defeated the Ming general Li Dingguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was ordered to assist General Zhuobutai. The army halted at Duyun and defeated the Ming commander Li Dingguo.

sentences.zh: 會師，克雲南。

translations.literal: The armies joined forces and captured Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The columns united and took Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以勘從征將士功罪不實，降一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because his assessment of the merits and faults of the campaign officers was found inaccurate, his rank was reduced by one grade to ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year his assessment of campaign officers' merits and faults was found faulty, and his rank was cut one grade to ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授靖東將軍，討棲霞土寇於七，擊破所據岠嵎山寨，七竄入海。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Pacification-General of the East, suppressed the Qixia bandit Yu Qi, stormed the Juyu mountain stockade he held, and Qi fled into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was made Pacification-General of the East, suppressed the Qixia bandit Yu Qi, stormed his Juyu mountain stronghold, and Qi fled out to sea.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 1.

sentences.zh: 六十年，以其子西安副都統阿祿疏請，追諡勇壯。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, at the memorial request of his son Alu, deputy lieutenant-general at Xi'an, he was posthumously given the title Yongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year his son Alu, deputy lieutenant-general at Xi'an, memorialized for a posthumous title, and he was named Yongzhuang.

sentences.zh: 費雅思哈，濟席哈弟也。

translations.literal: Feiyasih'a was Jixiha's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Feiyasih'a was Jixiha's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 初以巴牙喇壯達事太宗。

translations.literal: At first he served Taizong as a Vanguard dartachi.
translations.idiomatic: He first served Taizong as a Vanguard dartachi.

sentences.zh: 天聰六年，從伐察哈爾，分兵略大同，至朔州，城兵出戰，費雅思哈與甲喇額真道喇等擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against the Chahar, detached troops to raid toward Datong, reached Shuozhou, and when the city troops came out to fight, Feiyasih'a, together with jalan ejen Daola and others, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 6 he joined the Chahar campaign, sent a detachment toward Datong, and at Shuozhou routed the garrison with jalan ejen Daola and others.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，署巴牙喇纛章京，從貝勒岳託伐明，敗密雲步兵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he acted as Vanguard banner commander, followed Beile Yoto against the Ming, and defeated the Miyun infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he served as acting Vanguard banner commander under Beile Yoto against the Ming and routed the Miyun infantry.

sentences.zh: 五年，師圍錦州，明兵自松山、杏山赴援，費雅思哈禦戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the army besieged Jinzhou; Ming troops came to the relief from Songshan and Xingshan, and in each engagement Feiyasih'a met the enemy and won.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, during the Jinzhou siege, Ming relief columns came from Songshan and Xingshan, and Feiyasih'a won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，同甲喇額真哈寧阿擊敵城下，射殪三人，明總督洪承疇步隊自松山至，費雅思哈力戰卻敵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Jinzhou was besieged again; together with jalan ejen Haning'a he struck the enemy below the walls, shot and killed three men, and when Ming Governor Hong Chengchou's infantry came from Songshan, Feiyasih'a fought fiercely and drove the enemy back.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at the renewed Jinzhou siege, he and jalan ejen Haning'a fought below the walls and shot down three men. When Governor Hong Chengchou's infantry marched from Songshan, Feiyasih'a beat them back after a hard fight.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，追敗之慶都，授巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, pursued and defeated him at Qingdu, and was appointed a Vanguard company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass, struck Li Zicheng, routed him at Qingdu, and was appointed a Vanguard company commander.

sentences.zh: 從英親王阿濟格西討，二年春，次榆林，自成兵夜襲營，與巴牙喇纛章京車爾布等擊之走，追自成至武昌，屢破其壘；

translations.literal: He followed Prince Ying Ajige on the western expedition; in the spring of the second year the army halted at Yulin; Zicheng's troops raided the camp by night; together with Vanguard banner commander Che'erbu and others he drove them off, pursued Zicheng to Wuchang, and repeatedly stormed his stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Ying Ajige west. In the spring of the second year, at Yulin, Zicheng's men raided the camp by night; with Vanguard commander Che'erbu and others he drove them off, chased Zicheng to Wuchang, and stormed his strongpoints again and again.

sentences.zh: 又以舟師邀擊富池口，得舟三十。

translations.literal: He also used the fleet to intercept the enemy at Fuchikou and captured thirty boats.
translations.idiomatic: His fleet also intercepted the enemy at Fuchikou and seized thirty boats.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，道西安，分兵徇邠州。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge against Zhang Xianzhong, passed through Xi'an, and detached troops to march through Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge against Zhang Xianzhong, went by way of Xi'an, and sent a detachment through Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 其渠胡敬德以千餘人據三水西北山岡，費雅思哈與巴牙喇纛章京噶達渾破其壘，復與固山額真巴哈納擊叛將賀珍於雞頭關。

translations.literal: Their chieftain Hu Jingde held the hill ridges northwest of Sanshui with more than a thousand men; Feiyasih'a and Vanguard banner commander Gadahun stormed his stockade, and he again joined gushan ejen Bahana in attacking the rebel general He Zhen at Jitou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit chief Hu Jingde held the hills northwest of Sanshui with more than a thousand men. Feiyasih'a and Vanguard commander Gadahun stormed his fort, then joined gushan ejen Bahana against the rebel He Zhen at Jitou Pass.

sentences.zh: 師下四川，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: The army descended into Sichuan and won victory in repeated battles.
translations.idiomatic: The army pushed into Sichuan and won every battle it fought.

sentences.zh: 正藍旗兵為賊困，與噶達渾趨援，賊走。

translations.literal: Plain Blue Banner troops were trapped by bandits; together with Gadahun he hurried to the relief, and the bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Plain Blue Banner troops were trapped by bandits, he and Gadahun rushed to relieve them and the bandits fled.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls and he was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, he received the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 六年，從英親王討叛將薑瓖，掘塹圍城，瓖兵步騎萬餘來犯，費雅思哈先眾迎戰，瓖兵不得入城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Ying against the rebel general Jiang Xiang, dug trenches and besieged the city; Xiang's infantry and cavalry, more than ten thousand strong, came to attack; Feiyasih'a went ahead of the troops to meet them in battle, and Xiang's force could not enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Prince Ying against the rebel Jiang Xiang, dug trenches, and laid siege. When Xiang's ten thousand foot and horse attacked, Feiyasih'a led the van and kept them from entering the city.

sentences.zh: 瓖兵分踞左衛，陷汾州，窺太原，費雅思哈率巴牙喇兵伺擊，會師圍大同，瓖黨斬以降，進世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Xiang's troops separately held Zuowei, captured Fenzhou, and eyed Taiyuan; Feiyasih'a led Vanguard troops to strike when opportunity offered; the armies united in besieging Datong; Xiang's partisans beheaded him to surrender; his hereditary rank was advanced to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's forces seized Zuowei, took Fenzhou, and threatened Taiyuan. Feiyasih'a led the Vanguard in opportunistic strikes until the armies united to besiege Datong, where Xiang's followers killed him and surrendered. His hereditary rank rose to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 尋命率兵駐防湖南。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops garrisoned in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Hunan with his troops.

sentences.zh: 明將孫可望據辰州，費雅思哈與固山額真卓羅、梅勒額真泰什哈等，自澧州、常德進徵，可望棄城遁，縱火焚舟，阻我師。

translations.literal: The Ming general Sun Kewang held Chenzhou; Feiyasih'a, together with gushan ejen Zhuoluo, meile ejen Taishiha, and others, advanced from Lizhou and Changde; Kewang abandoned the city and fled, set fires and burned boats, and blocked our army.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming commander Sun Kewang held Chenzhou. Feiyasih'a, gushan ejen Zhuoluo, meile ejen Taishiha, and others advanced from Lizhou and Changde. Kewang abandoned the city, burned his boats, and tried to block the army's path.

sentences.zh: 費雅思哈取其未焚者以濟師，躡擊至瀘溪，殲敵甚眾。

translations.literal: Feiyasih'a took those boats that had not yet burned to ferry the army across, pursued in attack to Luxi, and annihilated a great number of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Feiyasih'a used the unburned boats to ferry the army across, pursued to Luxi, and destroyed a great part of the enemy force.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從將軍愛星阿入緬甸，得明桂王以歸。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed General Aisingga into Burma and brought back the Ming Prince of Gui captive.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he followed General Aisingga into Burma and brought the Ming Prince of Gui back as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 師還，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return his hereditary rank rose to third-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙十一年，卒，諡僖恪。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Kangxi he died and was given the posthumous title Xike.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 11 and was posthumously titled Xike.

sentences.zh: 子素丹，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Sudan has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sudan has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 噶達渾，納喇氏，滿洲正紅旗人，世居哈達。

translations.literal: Gadahun, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner whose family had long dwelt at Hada.
translations.idiomatic: Gadahun of the Nara clan was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner from a family that had long lived at Hada.

sentences.zh: 其先有約蘭者，當太祖時，率其子懋巴里等來歸。

translations.literal: His ancestor Yuelan, in the time of Taizu, led his son Maobali and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: An ancestor named Yuelan had submitted in Taizu's day, bringing his son Maobali and others with him.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，噶達渾以巴牙喇甲喇章京從太宗伐多羅特部，有功。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong, Gadahun as a Vanguard company commander followed Taizong in campaigning against the Dorbed tribes and performed meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2, as a Vanguard company commander, Gadahun followed Taizong against the Dorbed tribes and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，略山西，克應州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed the campaign against the Ming, raided through Shanxi, and captured Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the Ming campaign, raided through Shanxi, and took Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，從伐明，略中後所。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he followed the campaign against the Ming and raided toward Zhonghousuo.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5 he joined the Ming campaign and raided toward Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞等率師圍錦州，令領纛先進，敗杏山騎兵，設伏松山，斬十餘級，明兵營嶺上，擊破之；

translations.literal: Prince Rui Dorgon and others led the army to besiege Jinzhou; Gadahun was ordered to lead the banner standard in advance, defeated the Xingshan cavalry, set an ambush at Songshan, beheaded more than ten men, and when Ming troops camped on the ridge he attacked and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Rui Dorgon besieged Jinzhou, Gadahun led the van, routed the Xingshan cavalry, ambushed at Songshan, took more than ten heads, and smashed the Ming force camped on the ridge.

sentences.zh: 又從噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦勞薩追擊至北岡。

translations.literal: He again followed Gabushixian gushan i janggin Laosa in pursuit as far as Beigang.
translations.idiomatic: He then pursued with Gabushixian corps commander Laosa as far as Beigang.

sentences.zh: 七年，從豫親王多鐸攻寧遠，明兵躡我後，噶達渾先眾還擊，明兵潰走。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Prince Yu Dodo in the attack on Ningyuan; Ming troops followed close behind our force; Gadahun went ahead of the troops, turned back, and struck; the Ming troops broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the Ningyuan campaign under Prince Yu Dodo, Ming forces dogged the rear; Gadahun led the van in a counterattack and drove them off in rout.

sentences.zh: 師還，有巴牙喇兵達哈塔者，被創，僕，掖以歸。

translations.literal: When the army returned, a Vanguard soldier named Dahata had been wounded and fell; Gadahun supported him and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home a wounded Vanguard soldier named Dahata had fallen; Gadahun supported him and brought him in.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 從入關，擊李自成，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: He followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.
translations.idiomatic: He marched through the Pass, struck Li Zicheng, and received the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格擊自成至九宮山，三敗之。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in striking Zicheng as far as Jiugong Mountain and defeated him three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Zicheng to Jiugong Mountain and defeated him three times.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格下四川，次西安，分兵討叛將賀珍，徇邠州，其黨胡敬德屯三水，噶達渾與梅勒額真和託直入，破其壘。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan, halted at Xi'an, detached troops to suppress the rebel general He Zhen, marched through Binzhou, and when He's partisan Hu Jingde held Sanshui, Gadahun and meile ejen Hetuo pressed straight in and stormed his stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan, stopped at Xi'an, and sent detachments against the rebel He Zhen. At Binzhou, when He's man Hu Jingde held Sanshui, Gadahun and meile ejen Hetuo broke through and took his fort.

sentences.zh: 高汝礪、武大定等屯三寨山，復與巴牙喇纛章京蘇拜、哈寧阿，梅勒額真阿拉善擊敗之，督步卒搜剿巖谷。

translations.literal: Gao Ruli, Wu Dading, and others held Sanzhai Mountain; he again joined Vanguard banner commander Subai, Haning'a, and meile ejen Alashan in defeating them and directed infantry in searching out and suppressing the ravines and valleys.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Ruli and Wu Dading held Sanzhai Mountain, he joined Vanguard commander Subai, Haning'a, and meile ejen Alashan in defeating them and sent infantry to sweep the ravines.

sentences.zh: 大定等據山巔，其徒左右迎戰，噶達渾與巴牙喇纛章京阿爾津奮戰，挫其鋒。

translations.literal: Dading and others held the mountain crest; their followers met the attack on both flanks; Gadahun and Vanguard banner commander A'erjin fought fiercely and blunted their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: Dading held the summit while his men fought on both flanks; Gadahun and Vanguard commander A'erjin fought hard and blunted their attack.

sentences.zh: 大定等兵攻正藍旗營，哈寧阿陷圍中，噶達渾與阿爾津、蘇拜疾馳赴援，圍乃解。

translations.literal: Dading's troops attacked the Plain Blue Banner camp; Haning'a was trapped in the encirclement; Gadahun, A'erjin, and Subai galloped to the relief, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: When Dading's men besieged the Plain Blue Banner camp, Haning'a was trapped; Gadahun, A'erjin, and Subai galloped to the rescue and broke the encirclement.

sentences.zh: 擢戶部侍郎，五年，調吏部，進世職三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of Revenue; in the fifth year he was transferred to the Board of Civil Appointments, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: He became vice minister of Revenue; in the fifth year he moved to the Board of Civil Appointments and was raised to third-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 英親王阿濟格討叛將薑瓖，噶達渾與阿拉善濟師，七戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Prince Ying Ajige suppressed the rebel Jiang Xiang; Gadahun and Alashan joined the army, and in seven battles they won every one.
translations.idiomatic: On Prince Ying Ajige's campaign against the rebel Jiang Xiang, Gadahun and Alashan joined the force and won all seven battles.

sentences.zh: 克代州，進复渾源。

translations.literal: They captured Daizhou and advanced to recover Hunyuan.
translations.idiomatic: They took Daizhou and advanced to recover Hunyuan.

sentences.zh: 六年，兼本旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he concurrently served as gushan ejen of the Mongol banner of his own affiliation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he also served as gushan ejen of his banner's Mongol contingent.

sentences.zh: 七年，世祖親政，擢戶部尚書，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the Shizu Emperor took personal rule, he was promoted to minister of Revenue and his hereditary rank was advanced to the second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the Shizu Emperor assumed personal rule, he became minister of Revenue and his hereditary rank rose to the second grade.

sentences.zh: 改都察院左都御史，尋還為尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be left censor-in-chief of the Censorate and soon returned to serve again as minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was made left censor-in-chief of the Censorate, then soon returned to his ministership.

sentences.zh: 率師徵鄂爾多斯部，獲部長多爾濟，殲其眾於賀蘭山，進世職三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He led troops against the Ordos tribes, captured chieftain Duo'erji, annihilated their force at Helan Mountain, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: He led a campaign against the Ordos, captured chieftain Duo'erji, destroyed their force at Helan Mountain, and was raised to third-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 調滿洲固山額真、兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be gushan ejen of the Manchu banners and minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He became gushan ejen of the Manchu banners and minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十年，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the tenth year his hereditary rank was advanced to the second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his hereditary rank rose to the second grade.

sentences.zh: 世職呂忠行賕事發，部議引赦例貸其罪，坐降世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: The bribery case of hereditary officer Lü Zhongxing came to light; the ministry proposed applying an amnesty precedent to spare his punishment, and Gadahun was punished by reduction of his hereditary rank to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: When hereditary officer Lü Zhongxing's bribery scandal broke, the ministry cited an amnesty precedent to spare him, and Gadahun was reduced to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 大將軍鄭親王世子濟度討鄭成功，命噶達渾佐之，敕濟度調遣官兵，毋令噶達渾離左右。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince Zheng's heir Jidu campaigned against Zheng Chenggong; Gadahun was ordered to assist him, and Jidu was instructed in an edict to deploy officers and troops and not let Gadahun leave his side.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Marshal Prince Zheng's heir Jidu campaigned against Zheng Chenggong, Gadahun was ordered to assist him, with an edict telling Jidu to keep Gadahun at his side in all deployments.

sentences.zh: 克海澄，水陸並進，复福州，遂下泉州，攻惠安海港衛套及閩安鎮，大捷。

translations.literal: They captured Haicheng, advanced by land and water together, recovered Fuzhou, then took Quanzhou, attacked the Huian coastal guard bays and Min'an Town, and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: They took Haicheng, advanced by land and sea, recovered Fuzhou, then Quanzhou, stormed the Huian coastal defenses and Min'an Town, and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 十四年，師還。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: The army returned in the fourteenth year.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太字太保，諡敏壯。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the temple name Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 同族有費揚武、愛松古、興鼐。

translations.literal: Among his clansmen were Feiyangwu, Aisonggu, and Xingnai.
translations.idiomatic: His clan also produced Feiyangwu, Aisonggu, and Xingnai.

sentences.zh: 費揚武，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Feiyangwu was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Feiyangwu was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初自巴牙喇壯達累遷甲喇額真。

translations.literal: At first, rising from Vanguard dartachi, he was promoted step by step to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from Vanguard dartachi through successive promotions to jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德七年，從饒餘貝勒阿巴泰伐明，入塞，擊敗明總兵馬科。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde he followed Raoyu Beile Abatai in a campaign against the Ming, entered the frontier passes, and defeated Ming regional commander Ma Ke.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 7 he followed Raoyu Beile Abatai against the Ming, crossed into the passes, and routed regional commander Ma Ke.

sentences.zh: 越明都，略山東，次膠州，明兵千餘屯城外，費揚武力戰破之；

translations.literal: They passed the Ming capital, raided through Shandong, and halted at Jiaozhou; more than a thousand Ming troops were encamped outside the city, and Feiyangwu fought fiercely and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: They passed the Ming capital and raided Shandong, stopping at Jiaozhou, where more than a thousand Ming troops lay outside the walls; Feiyangwu fought them off.

sentences.zh: 攻濱州，以雲梯先登。

translations.literal: In the attack on Binzhou he was first over the wall on scaling ladders.
translations.idiomatic: At Binzhou he was first up the wall on scaling ladders.

sentences.zh: 出塞，明總督范志完、總兵吳三桂等分道要我師，費揚武先後與戰皆勝，護所俘獲還。

translations.literal: On leaving the passes, Ming Governor Fan Zhiwan, regional commander Wu Sangui, and others blocked our army on separate routes; Feiyangwu fought them in succession and won each time, protecting the captives and booty on the march home.
translations.idiomatic: On the withdrawal, Ming governor Fan Zhiwan, Wu Sangui, and others intercepted the column on several routes; Feiyangwu won every engagement and escorted the prisoners and booty home.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，敗其騎兵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and defeated his cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he marched through the Pass, struck Li Zicheng, and routed his cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尋署巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he acted as Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 從豫親王多鐸西討自成，次潼關，破自成將劉宗敏。
