translations.literal: He followed Prince Yu Dodo on the western expedition against Zicheng, halted at Tong Pass, and defeated Zicheng's general Liu Zongmin.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Yu Dodo west against Zicheng, halted at Tong Pass, and broke Liu Zongmin.

sentences.zh: 二年，從定江南，攻揚州，得舟二百餘。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed the pacification of the lower Yangzi, attacked Yangzhou, and captured more than two hundred boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, during the pacification of the lower Yangzi, he took Yangzhou and seized more than two hundred boats.

sentences.zh: 攻明南都，敗其步兵。

translations.literal: He attacked the Southern Ming capital and defeated its infantry.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted the Southern Ming capital and routed its infantry.

sentences.zh: 逐明福王至蕪湖，與明總兵黃得功戰，得舟三十有一。

translations.literal: He pursued the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu, fought Ming regional commander Huang Degong, and captured thirty-one boats.
translations.idiomatic: He chased the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu, fought Huang Degong, and took thirty-one boats.

sentences.zh: 旋從端重親王博洛下浙江，破明馬士英軍於杭州，生致明總兵一，分兵定海寧、平湖土寇；

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo into Zhejiang, defeated Ma Shiying's Ming army at Hangzhou, captured one Ming regional commander alive, and detached troops to pacify bandits in Haining and Pinghu.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo into Zhejiang, routed Ma Shiying at Hangzhou, took a Ming commander alive, and sent detachments to pacify bandits in Haining and Pinghu.

sentences.zh: 又與明總兵王之仁戰，得舟十有六：授議政大臣，予世職甲喇章京，加半個前程。

translations.literal: He again fought Ming regional commander Wang Zhiren and captured sixteen boats; he was appointed a deliberative minister, granted the hereditary rank of jalan janggin, and given half a qianjing.
translations.idiomatic: He also fought Wang Zhiren and took sixteen boats. He was made a deliberative minister, granted the hereditary rank of jalan janggin, and received half a qianjing.

sentences.zh: 四年，從軍福建。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the army into Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he served on the Fujian campaign.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 愛松古，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Aisonggu was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Aisonggu was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 太祖時，自葉赫來歸，屢從征伐。

translations.literal: In the time of Taizu he came over from Yehe and repeatedly followed campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: In Taizu's day he came over from Yehe and fought in campaign after campaign.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，命與察漢喇嘛等赴明邊殺虎口互市。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he was ordered, together with Chahan Lama and others, to go to the Ming frontier at the Shahu Pass market.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he was sent with Chahan Lama and others to the Ming frontier market at Shahu Pass.

sentences.zh: 復遣往科爾沁徵兵。

translations.literal: He was again dispatched to the Khorchin to levy troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent to the Khorchin to levy troops.

sentences.zh: 三年，初設理籓院，授副理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year, when the Court of Colonial Affairs was first established, he was appointed a deputy managing official.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when the Court of Colonial Affairs was founded, he was made a deputy managing official.

sentences.zh: 尋自歸化城導厄魯特部長墨爾根戴青來歸。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he guided Olot chieftain Mo'ergendaiqing from Guihuacheng to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He soon guided Olot chieftain Mo'ergendaiqing from Guihuacheng to submit.

sentences.zh: 再坐事鞭責。

translations.literal: He again was punished by flogging for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He was flogged again for another offense.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 從固山額真葉臣徇山西。

translations.literal: He followed gushan ejen Yechen in a sweep through Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He followed gushan ejen Yechen on a sweep through Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時李自成西走，其將陳永福據太原，發砲攻城圮，永福突​​圍走，愛松古以蒙古兵戰，多斬馘，得馬千餘。

translations.literal: At that time Li Zicheng was fleeing west; his general Chen Yongfu held Taiyuan; cannon fire breached the city walls; Yongfu broke out and fled; Aisonggu fought with Mongol troops, beheaded and killed many, and captured more than a thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng was fleeing west while his general Chen Yongfu held Taiyuan. When cannon fire breached the walls Yongfu broke out and fled. Aisonggu fought with his Mongol troops, killed many, and seized more than a thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 又逐自成將馬驥至河濱，得舟十五。

translations.literal: He again pursued Zicheng's general Ma Ji to the riverbank and captured fifteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: He also chased Zicheng's general Ma Ji to the river and took fifteen boats.

sentences.zh: 二年，從圍延安，城兵出戰，擊卻之，以八騎躡自成，獲其孥。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed the siege of Yan'an; the garrison came out to fight and he drove them back; with eight horsemen he pursued Zicheng and captured his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, during the siege of Yan'an, he beat back a sally, then with eight horsemen chased Zicheng and captured his family.

sentences.zh: 三年，從豫親王多鐸討蘇尼特部長騰機思，將蒙古兵三百先驅扼隘，師繼進，騰機思遁走，從侍郎尼堪、梅勒額真明安達里乘夜追擊，得其輜重；

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo against Sunite chieftain Tengjisi, led three hundred Mongol troops as vanguard to hold the passes, the army followed in support, Tengjisi fled, and following vice minister Nikan and meile ejen Mingandali he pursued by night and seized his baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Yu Dodo against Sunite chieftain Tengjisi, holding the passes with three hundred Mongol vanguard troops. When Tengjisi fled, he joined vice minister Nikan and meile ejen Mingandali in a night pursuit and seized the baggage train.

sentences.zh: 斬台吉茂海，遂渡圖喇河，土謝圖汗以二萬人拒戰，從鎮國將軍瓦克達等敗其騎兵。

translations.literal: He beheaded taiji Maohai, then crossed the Tula River; the Tushiyetu Khan resisted with twenty thousand men, and following Defender of the State Wakeda and others he defeated their cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He killed taiji Maohai, crossed the Tula River, and with Defender of the State Wakeda routed the twenty thousand horsemen of the Tushiyetu Khan.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls and he was granted the hereditary rank of tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, he received the hereditary rank of tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 五年，命率蒙古兵六百駐太原，擊斬涇陽寇李陽，敗交城寇王豪明。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to lead six hundred Mongol troops garrisoned at Taiyuan, attacked and beheaded the Jingyang bandit Li Yang, and defeated the Jiaocheng bandit Wang Haoming.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he garrisoned Taiyuan with six hundred Mongol troops, killed the Jingyang bandit Li Yang, and defeated the Jiaocheng bandit Wang Haoming.

sentences.zh: 時叛將薑瓖據大同，其黨劉遷以萬餘人犯代州，愛松古馳往守禦。

translations.literal: At that time the rebel Jiang Xiang held Datong; his partisan Liu Qian came to attack Daizhou with more than ten thousand men, and Aisonggu galloped there to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: While the rebel Jiang Xiang held Datong, his follower Liu Qian invaded Daizhou with more than ten thousand men, and Aisonggu rushed to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 遷眾傅雲梯乘城，鉤致其梯九，斬級三百；

translations.literal: Qian's force set up scaling ladders against the wall; Aisonggu hooked away nine of the ladders and beheaded three hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's men raised scaling ladders; Aisonggu hooked away nine ladders and took three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 遷眾穴城，城上發矢石，遷眾多殪，乃走繁峙。

translations.literal: Qian's force tunneled into the city; arrows and stones were rained from the walls; many of Qian's men were killed, and they fled toward Fanshi.
translations.idiomatic: When Qian's men tried to tunnel in, the defenders rained arrows and stones from the walls, killed many of them, and drove them off toward Fanshi.

sentences.zh: 六年，復來襲，有為應者，引入郛，愛松古嬰城守十餘日，端重親王博洛師至，擊斬其渠郭芳，遷遁去。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they came to raid again; there were collaborators who let them into the outer city; Aisonggu held the inner city in a desperate defense for more than ten days; Prince Duanzhong Bolo's army arrived, struck and beheaded their leader Guo Fang, and Qian fled away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they raided again; collaborators opened the outer city. Aisonggu held the inner walls for more than ten days until Prince Duanzhong Bolo arrived, killed their leader Guo Fang, and drove Qian off.

sentences.zh: 乃還駐太原，瓖黨十餘萬來犯，愛松古與巡撫祝世昌謀遣兵赴清源徐溝防禦，不使逼城下。

translations.literal: He then returned to garrison Taiyuan; more than a hundred thousand of Xiang's partisans came to attack; Aisonggu and governor Zhu Shichang planned to send troops to Qingyuan and Xugou for defense so they would not press close under the walls.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Taiyuan, where more than a hundred thousand of Xiang's followers attacked. With governor Zhu Shichang he sent troops to Qingyuan and Xugou to keep the enemy from reaching the walls.

sentences.zh: 端重親王師自晉陽至，破賊。

translations.literal: Prince Duanzhong's army came from Jinyang and defeated the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Duanzhong's army came up from Jinyang and broke the rebels.

sentences.zh: 累擢鑲白旗蒙古梅勒額真，世職累進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was promoted in stages to meile ejen of the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and his hereditary rank was advanced in stages to second-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to meile ejen of the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and his hereditary rank climbed to second-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 九年，從敬謹親王尼堪南征，王沒於陣，愛松古不及救，降世職拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Prince Jingjin Nikan on the southern expedition; the prince fell in battle and Aisonggu could not rescue him in time; his hereditary rank was reduced to tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Prince Jingjin Nikan south. The prince was killed in battle before Aisonggu could reach him, and his rank was cut to tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he retired.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 14.

sentences.zh: 子訥青，以三等侍衛從討鄭成功，至廈門，卒於軍。

translations.literal: His son Neqing, a third-rank bodyguard, followed the campaign against Zheng Chenggong, reached Xiamen, and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: His son Neqing, a third-rank bodyguard, served against Zheng Chenggong, reached Xiamen, and died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 興鼐，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Xingnai was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Xingnai was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父素巴海，自哈達率二百人來歸，太祖編牛錄，授其長子莽果，興鼐其第三子也。

translations.literal: His father Subahai came over from Hada leading two hundred men; Taizu organized a niru and gave it to his eldest son Mangguo; Xingnai was his third son.
translations.idiomatic: His father Subahai came from Hada with two hundred followers; Taizu formed a niru under the eldest son Mangguo, and Xingnai was the third son.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，天聰八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: He served Taizong; in the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He served Taizong and in Tiancong 8 received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從英親王阿濟格伐明，佐固山額真達爾罕攻順義，先登，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Ying Ajige against the Ming, assisted gushan ejen Da'erhan in attacking Shunyi, was first over the wall, and was granted half a qianjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ying Ajige against the Ming, helped gushan ejen Da'erhan take Shunyi, was first up the wall, and earned half a qianjing.

sentences.zh: 三年，授工部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed an acting official of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he became an acting official in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 考滿，進世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When his performance review was complete, his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: After a satisfactory performance review his hereditary rank rose to third-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，西討李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass and campaigned west against Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass and campaigned west against Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 自成之徒自延安出犯，截擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Zicheng's followers came out from Yan'an to raid; he intercepted them and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When Zicheng's followers sallied from Yan'an, he intercepted them and routed them utterly.

sentences.zh: 逐自成至武昌，躡之至富池口，列陣河岸，與巴牙喇纛章京哈寧阿、甲喇額真希爾根擊之潰。

translations.literal: He pursued Zicheng to Wuchang, followed close to Fuchikou, drew up battle formation on the riverbank, and together with Vanguard banner commander Haning'a and jalan ejen Xiergen struck and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: He chased Zicheng to Wuchang and on to Fuchikou, where he drew up along the bank with Haning'a and jalan ejen Xiergen and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 移軍江南，與巴牙喇甲喇額真布克沙敗明將黃蜚於池州，斬級二百，得舟十二。

translations.literal: The army shifted to the lower Yangzi region; together with jalan ejen Bukexi he defeated the Ming general Huang Fei at Chizhou, beheaded two hundred men, and captured twelve boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the lower Yangzi he and jalan ejen Bukexi defeated Huang Fei at Chizhou, took two hundred heads, and seized twelve boats.

sentences.zh: 三年，從討蘇尼特部長騰機思，戰敗土謝圖汗、碩類汗二部兵。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Sunite chieftain Tengjisi and defeated the forces of the Tushiyetu and Shulei khans.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Sunite chieftain Tengjisi and defeated the armies of the Tushiyetu and Shulei khans.

sentences.zh: 擢工部侍郎，累進世職二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of Works, and his hereditary rank was advanced in stages to second-class ashanihafan.
translations.idiomatic: He became vice minister of Works, and his hereditary rank rose step by step to second-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以勘羅源戰敗將士有所徇，奪官，削世職。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because in assessing the defeated officers at Luoyuan he had shown favoritism, he was stripped of office and his hereditary rank was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was dismissed and stripped of his hereditary rank for showing favoritism when assessing the officers defeated at Luoyuan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，聖祖即位，复授一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Sacred Ancestor took the throne, he was again granted first-class adahahan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Kangxi Emperor ascended the throne, he was restored to first-class adahahan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 3.

sentences.zh: 哈爾奇，莽果孫也。

translations.literal: Ha'erqi was Mangguo's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Ha'erqi was Mangguo's grandson.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，以巴牙喇壯達從軍。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi he followed the army as a Vanguard dartachi.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 he entered service as a Vanguard dartachi.

sentences.zh: 鄭成功內犯，自荊州援江寧，破成功將楊文英。

translations.literal: When Zheng Chenggong invaded inland, he went from Jingzhou to relieve Jiangning and defeated Chenggong's general Yang Wenying.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Chenggong invaded inland, he marched from Jingzhou to relieve Jiangning and defeated Yang Wenying.

sentences.zh: 署巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He acted as Vanguard company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting Vanguard company commander.

sentences.zh: 討耿精忠，迭戰敗其將楊益茂於九江、邵聯登於建昌，又敗吳三桂將夏國相於萍鄉、謝勝先於瀏陽、吳國貴於武岡。

translations.literal: In suppressing Geng Jingzhong he fought in succession and defeated his generals Yang Yimao at Jiujiang and Shao Liandeng at Jianchang, and again defeated Wu Sangui's generals Xia Guoxiang at Pingxiang, Xie Shengxian at Liuyang, and Wu Guogui at Wugang.
translations.idiomatic: Against Geng Jingzhong he defeated Yang Yimao at Jiujiang and Shao Liandeng at Jianchang, then routed Wu Sangui's Xia Guoxiang at Pingxiang, Xie Shengxian at Liuyang, and Wu Guogui at Wugang.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were entered on the rolls and he was granted tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: When his service was reckoned for reward, he received tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 達素，章佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，先世居費雅朗阿。

translations.literal: Dasu, of the Zhangjia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner whose forebears had long dwelt at Feiyalang'a.
translations.idiomatic: Dasu of the Zhangjia clan was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner from a family that had long lived at Feiyalang'a.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，以巴牙喇壯達從伐明，圍大凌河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong, as a Vanguard dartachi, he followed the campaign against the Ming and besieged Dalinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5, as a Vanguard dartachi, he joined the Ming campaign and helped besiege Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 明兵來援，與巴牙喇壯達鰲拜同擊卻之。

translations.literal: Ming troops came to the relief; together with Vanguard dartachi Oboi he fought them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming relief troops arrived, he and Vanguard dartachi Oboi drove them back.

sentences.zh: 略明邊，斬敵騎。

translations.literal: He raided the Ming frontier and beheaded enemy horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: On a raid along the Ming frontier he killed enemy horsemen.

sentences.zh: 師還，擢巴牙喇甲喇額真。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was promoted to Vanguard jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was promoted to Vanguard jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，從圍錦州，敗杏山明兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he followed the siege of Jinzhou and defeated the Ming troops at Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5, during the Jinzhou siege, he routed the Ming force at Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，明兵數十人據塔山，列火器拒守。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Jinzhou was besieged again; several dozen Ming soldiers held Tashan, arrayed firearms, and resisted in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Jinzhou was besieged again, several dozen Ming soldiers held Tashan behind a line of firearms.

sentences.zh: 達素率六騎馳而上，盡斬之；

translations.literal: Dasu led six horsemen in a gallop up the height and beheaded them all.
translations.idiomatic: Dasu charged up the height with six horsemen and cut them all down.

sentences.zh: 复率兵邀擊，明兵走海岸，溺死者無算。

translations.literal: He again led troops in an intercepting attack; the Ming soldiers fled toward the coast, and those who drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He intercepted them again; the Ming troops fled to the coast, and countless men drowned.

sentences.zh: 七年，從徇寧遠，敗明騎兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed a raid toward Ningyuan and defeated Ming cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined a raid toward Ningyuan and routed Ming cavalry.

sentences.zh: 八年，從巴牙喇纛章京阿爾津等伐虎爾哈部，克博和理城，又招降能吉爾、大噶爾達蘇諸屯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Vanguard banner commander A'erjin and others in campaigning against the Hurha tribes, captured Boheli city, and also accepted the surrender of the settlements of Nengji'er, Dag'erdasu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Vanguard commander A'erjin against the Hurha tribes, took Boheli, and brought over the settlements of Nengji'er and Dag'erdasu.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass and attacked Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass and struck Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 從固山額真巴哈納等徇山西，克絳州，逐賊至黃河。

translations.literal: He followed gushan ejen Bahana and others in a sweep through Shanxi, captured Jiangzhou, and pursued the bandits to the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: He followed gushan ejen Bahana through Shanxi, took Jiangzhou, and chased the rebels to the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 賊以舟濟，達素督兵射之，賊多墮水死。

translations.literal: The bandits crossed by boat; Dasu directed the troops to shoot at them, and many of the bandits fell into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: As the rebels ferried across, Dasu had his men shoot them down; many fell into the river and drowned.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格下湖廣，討自成，克安陸、武昌，逐之至富池口，賊營對岸，達素先諸將衝擊，多所俘獲。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige into Huguang to suppress Zicheng, captured Anlu and Wuchang, pursued him to Fuchikou, where the bandits were encamped on the opposite bank; Dasu charged ahead of the other generals and took many captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige into Huguang against Zicheng, took Anlu and Wuchang, and chased him to Fuchikou. When the rebels camped on the far bank, Dasu led the charge ahead of the other generals and took many prisoners.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，道漢中，擊破賀珍，下四川，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge against Zhang Xianzhong, passed through Hanzhong, defeated He Zhen, descended into Sichuan, and won victory in repeated battles.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge against Zhang Xianzhong, went through Hanzhong, broke He Zhen, pushed into Sichuan, and won every battle he fought.

sentences.zh: 積戰功，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: For accumulated military merit he was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated service he received the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan with tosaha fan.

sentences.zh: 六年，從英親王阿濟格討姜瓖，戰於右衛，賊大至，達素奮前搏擊，飛矢及其喉，手足皆創，墮馬。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Jiang Xiang; they fought at Youwei; the bandits came in great force; Dasu fought forward with desperate blows; a flying arrow struck his throat, his hands and feet were all wounded, and he fell from his horse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, fighting Jiang Xiang with Prince Ying Ajige at Youwei, Dasu charged into a mass of rebels. An arrow struck his throat, he was wounded in hands and feet, and fell from his horse.

sentences.zh: 軍校欲負以退，叱曰：「死則死耳，何避為？

translations.literal: An officer of the army wished to carry him off the field, but he shouted, "If I am to die, then let me die—why flee?"
translations.idiomatic: When an officer tried to carry him from the field, he shouted, "If I die, I die—why run?"

sentences.zh: 」裹創督兵复戰，瓖兵敗卻。

translations.literal: He bound his wounds, directed the troops, and fought again; Xiang's force was defeated and driven back.
translations.idiomatic: He bound his wounds, rallied his men, and fought on until Xiang's troops broke and fell back.

sentences.zh: 世職累進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was advanced in stages to first-class adahahan.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank rose step by step to first-class adahahan.

sentences.zh: 九年，從敬謹親王尼堪徵湖南，次衡州。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Prince Jingjin Nikan in the Hunan campaign and halted at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Prince Jingjin Nikan into Hunan and halted at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 貝勒屯齊令別將兵诇敵寶慶，遇敵，擊敗之，進攻全州，破寨五，斬所置文武吏九及其徒四千餘，復興安、灌陽，复斬定國將倪兆龍。

translations.literal: Beile Tunqi ordered a separate detachment to scout the enemy at Baoqing; they met the enemy and defeated them, advanced to attack Quanzhou, stormed five stockades, beheaded nine civil and military officials he had installed together with more than four thousand of their followers, recovered Xing'an and Guanyang, and again beheaded Dingguo's general Ni Zhaolong.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Tunqi sent a detached column to scout at Baoqing, defeated the enemy there, and advanced on Quanzhou. Five stockades were taken, nine officials and more than four thousand followers were killed, Xing'an and Guanyang were recovered, and Dingguo's general Ni Zhaolong was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 敬謹親王沒於陣，將佐俱坐罪，達素以別將兵克敵，得免議。

translations.literal: Prince Jingjin fell in battle and his staff were all punished; Dasu, because his detached force had defeated the enemy, was exempted from censure.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Jingjin was killed, his staff were all punished, but Dasu escaped censure because his detached column had won its fights.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢內大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became an inner minister.

sentences.zh: 十六年，鄭成功內犯江寧，授達素安南將軍，同固山額真索渾、巴牙喇纛章京賴塔等率師赴援，至則成功已敗走，移師赴福建​​。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, when Zheng Chenggong invaded inland against Jiangning, Dasu was appointed Pacification-General of the South; together with gushan ejen Suohun, Vanguard banner commander Laita, and others he led troops to the relief; when they arrived Chenggong had already been defeated and fled, and the army shifted to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, when Zheng Chenggong struck inland at Jiangning, Dasu was made Pacification-General of the South. With gushan ejen Suohun, Vanguard commander Laita, and others he marched to relieve the city, but Chenggong had already fled, so the army turned toward Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十八年，召還。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，鰲拜敗，達素為所引用，坐罷官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, when Oboi fell, Dasu had been promoted through his patronage and was punished by dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8, when Oboi fell, Dasu was dismissed because he had risen through Oboi's patronage.

sentences.zh: 尋复世職。

translations.literal: Soon afterward his hereditary rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 同族有喀爾塔喇。

translations.literal: Among his clansmen was Ka'ertala.
translations.idiomatic: His clan also produced Ka'ertala.

sentences.zh: 喀爾塔喇，滿洲鑲白旗人，先世亦居費雅朗阿。

translations.literal: Ka'ertala was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner; his forebears also had long dwelt at Feiyalang'a.
translations.idiomatic: Ka'ertala was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner from a family that had also long lived at Feiyalang'a.

sentences.zh: 父圖爾坤詹，當太祖時，率五子及所部百餘戶來歸，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Tuerkunzhan, in the time of Taizu, led five sons and more than a hundred households of his following to submit and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tuerkunzhan submitted in Taizu's day with five sons and more than a hundred households and was made niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 卒，喀爾塔喇嗣，事太宗。

translations.literal: When he died, Ka'ertala succeeded him and served Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On his death Ka'ertala inherited the post and served Taizong.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，以巴牙喇甲喇章京從豫親王多鐸伐明，略寧遠，將入邊，破明兵；

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, as a Vanguard company commander, he followed Prince Yu Dodo against the Ming, raided toward Ningyuan, was about to enter the frontier, and defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3, as a Vanguard company commander under Prince Yu Dodo, he raided toward Ningyuan and routed Ming troops on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 及還，又連敗之。

translations.literal: On the return march he again defeated them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home he defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，城兵出犯鑲黃旗分守壕塹，坐退避，罪當死，上命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the siege of Jinzhou; the garrison came out and attacked the Bordered Yellow Banner detachment guarding the trenches; he was punished for retreating; by law the offense merited death, but the emperor ordered a fine in lieu of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, during the Jinzhou siege, he retreated when the garrison struck the Bordered Yellow Banner trench guard. The statute called for death, but the emperor accepted a fine instead.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，將本旗敗其騎兵，逐之至慶都，盡殲其後隊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass and attacked Li Zicheng; he led his banner to defeat Zicheng's cavalry, pursued him to Qingdu, and annihilated his rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through the Pass against Li Zicheng, routed his cavalry with the banner force, chased him to Qingdu, and destroyed his rear guard.

sentences.zh: 旋從固山額真巴哈納等徇懷慶，入山西境，破賊黃河渡口，逐之至榆林。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed gushan ejen Bahana and others in a sweep through Huaqing, entered Shanxi territory, broke the bandits at a Yellow River crossing, and pursued them to Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed gushan ejen Bahana through Huaqing into Shanxi, broke the rebels at a Yellow River ford, and pursued them to Yulin.

sentences.zh: 二年，自成走湖廣，移師從之。

translations.literal: In the second year Zicheng fled into Huguang and the army shifted to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, when Zicheng fled into Huguang, the army turned to follow him.

sentences.zh: 與巴牙喇甲喇章京鰲拜攻克安陸，督兵進剿，毀其壘，得舟六十餘。

translations.literal: Together with Vanguard company commander Oboi he stormed Anlu, directed troops in pursuit, destroyed their stockades, and captured more than sixty boats.
translations.idiomatic: With Vanguard commander Oboi he took Anlu, led the pursuit, destroyed their strongpoints, and seized more than sixty boats.

sentences.zh: 五年，從大將軍譚泰討金聲桓，師次童子渡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Grand Marshal Tan Tai against Jin Shenghuan; the army halted at Tongzi Ford.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Grand Marshal Tan Tai against Jin Shenghuan and halted at Tongzi Ford.

sentences.zh: 聲桓兵據水而陣，方舟為梁，喀爾塔喇奪以渡師，分兵趨饒州。

translations.literal: Shenghuan's troops held the water line in battle formation and lashed boats together as a bridge; Ka'ertala seized it to ferry the army across and detached troops toward Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shenghuan's men held the water with a pontoon of boats; Ka'ertala seized it to get the army across and sent a detachment toward Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 聲桓遣別將以三千人迎戰，喀爾塔喇與甲喇額真巴朗等擊敗之，克饒州。

translations.literal: Shenghuan sent a separate commander with three thousand men to meet the attack; Ka'ertala, together with jalan ejen Balang and others, defeated them and captured Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shenghuan sent three thousand men under a separate commander; Ka'ertala and jalan ejen Balang routed them and took Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 進次南昌，營甫定，葲桓兵出戰，奮戰，挫其鋒。

translations.literal: They advanced and halted at Nanchang; the camp had just been set when Shenghuan's troops came out to fight; he fought fiercely and blunted their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanchang, as the camp was still being laid out, Shenghuan's men sallied; Ka'ertala fought hard and blunted their attack.

sentences.zh: 師合圍，喀爾塔喇屯江岸，聲桓兵以舟運糧入城，喀爾塔喇邀擊，得舟八，又縱火焚舟七百餘，師次城北。

translations.literal: When the armies closed the encirclement, Ka'ertala was stationed on the riverbank; Shenghuan's troops used boats to transport grain into the city; Ka'ertala intercepted them, captured eight boats, and also set fires that burned more than seven hundred boats; the army halted north of the city.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege Ka'ertala held the riverbank. When Shenghuan tried to ferry grain into the city by boat, Ka'ertala intercepted eight vessels and burned more than seven hundred others, while the army encamped north of the city.

sentences.zh: 喀爾塔喇與甲喇額真艮泰分兵攻城南，六年春，克南昌。

translations.literal: Ka'ertala and jalan ejen Genta divided their forces to attack the south of the city; in the spring of the sixth year Nanchang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Ka'ertala and jalan ejen Genta attacked the south gate in the spring of the sixth year and took Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to Vanguard banner commander.

sentences.zh: 從敬謹親王尼堪徵湖南衡州，乘勝疾進，遇伏，力戰，與王同沒於陣。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Jingjin Nikan in the Hunan campaign at Hengzhou, pressed forward swiftly on the momentum of victory, met an ambush, fought fiercely, and fell in battle together with the prince.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Jingjin Nikan to Hengzhou in Hunan, pressed forward in victory, walked into an ambush, fought to the end, and fell with the prince.

sentences.zh: 喀爾塔喇積戰功，世職累進一等哈達哈哈番，卹進三等阿思哈尼哈番，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: For accumulated military merit Ka'ertala's hereditary rank had been advanced in stages to first-class hadahafan; in condolence it was raised to third-class ashanihafan, and he was given the posthumous title Zhongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: For long service Ka'ertala had risen to first-class hadahafan; posthumously he was raised to third-class ashanihafan and titled Zhongzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子赫特赫，襲。

translations.literal: His son Heteh inherited the rank.
translations.idiomatic: His son Heteh inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以甲喇額真從討鄭成功，攻廈門，戰死，予世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, as jalan ejen, he followed the campaign against Zheng Chenggong, attacked Xiamen, died in battle, and was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he served as jalan ejen against Zheng Chenggong, attacked Xiamen, was killed in battle, and was granted the hereditary rank of tabuleha fan.

sentences.zh: 論曰：滿洲諸大家多以地為氏，往往氏同而所自出異。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Many great Manchu houses took their surnames from place-names, and often the surname was the same while the line of origin differed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe that many great Manchu houses took place-names as clan designations, so the same name often masked different lines of descent.

sentences.zh: 戰績既著，門材遂張。

translations.literal: Once military achievements were manifest, the talent of the house spread and flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Once their battlefield records were established, the talent of each house spread and flourished.

sentences.zh: 濟席哈、達素嘗專將，雖所當非大敵，或未與敵遇，要其才望必有足以勝此任者。

translations.literal: Jixiha and Dasu once held independent command; although the opponents they faced were not always great enemies, and sometimes they did not even meet the enemy, in essentials their ability and standing must have been sufficient to justify such appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Jixiha and Dasu once held independent commands. Their opponents were not always formidable, and sometimes they never met the enemy at all, yet their ability and standing were clearly enough to justify such appointments.

sentences.zh: 果科等皆以裨佐樹績行間，勳閥所存，亦不得而略焉。

translations.literal: Guoke and the others all built achievement on campaign as staff officers and subordinates; what the houses of merit preserve cannot be passed over either.
translations.idiomatic: Guoke and the others won their records as staff officers in the field; what these meritorious houses preserved cannot be passed over in the account either.
